reads.note: Gmail v2.1 message getAll, returnAll, simple (default): GET /messages?q=<expression> (one page, no nextPageToken), then GET /messages/<id>?format=metadata&metadataHeaders=From,To,Cc,Bcc,Subject per message, then GET /labels for the simplified labels (n8n-nodes-base 2.47.7 GmailV2 and simplifyOutput). The q expression reads new Date() (the wall clock), so the query is not matched

branches: no IF/Switch: fetch → aggregate → summarise → send
expect.offline: The Gmail query and the summary subject read new Date() (the run's wall clock, in the workflow's Asia/Kolkata zone), so their dates follow the run, not `now`. Send Summary goes to user@example.com with cc user@example.com, as the template ships
